```{r}
#| label: download

# Download all data
library(fs)

if (!dir_exists("DATA")) {
  message(glue::glue("Creating directory DATA in {getwd()}"))
  dir_create("DATA")
}

dl_resource <- function(name, url) {
  p <- path("DATA", name)
  if (!file_exists(p)) {
    message(glue::glue("Downloading {name}"))
    download.file(url, p)
    message(glue::glue("Downloaded {name}"))
  }
}

dl_resource(
  "monmaster.csv",
  "https://data.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/fr-esr-mon_master/exports/csv"
)

dl_resource(
  "metadata.pdf",
  "https://data.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/fr-esr-mon_master/attachments/methodologie_opendata_monmaster_2025pdf"
)

dl_resource(
  "academies.geojson",
  "https://data.education.gouv.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/fr-en-contour-academies-2020/exports/geojson"
)

detach(package:fs)

```

{{< include _utils.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Load data into R objects
monmaster <-
  read_delim("DATA/monmaster.csv", delim = ';', col_types = monmaster_types) |>
  mutate(disci_master = fct(str_replace_all(disci_master, "\\.", "")))

monmaster24 <- filter(monmaster, session == "2024") |> select(!session)
monmaster25 <- filter(monmaster, session == "2025") |> select(!session)

academies <-
  read_sf("DATA/academies.geojson") |>
  # Make column names and types match with the ones from monmaster
  mutate(
    .keep = "none",
    acad = ordered(paste0("A", code_academie), levels = code_acad),
    acad_lib = name,
    acad_lib_maj = libelle_aca_majuscules,
    acad_reg = ordered(paste0("R", code_region_2016), levels = code_region),
    acad_reg_lib = libelle_region_2016,
    geometry = geometry
  )

suppressWarnings(
  academies_metro <- st_crop(academies, xmin = -5, xmax = 10, ymin = 41, ymax = 52)
)

```
